trigger: Deal 36874 repeat order was rejected because KN-4710 #11020 had one unit in Bin and one unit remaining in the plan. No new Material Request was created by that attempt.
decision: User explicitly requires ordering even when book stock is sufficient: an item can be missing in reality, broken or unsuitable as a display sample. Retain the existing order action and protection from unfinished requests. No additional button or automatic reserve.

retiredRule.oldUi: Repeat order action hidden when calculated shortage was zero; default quantity subtracted book stock.
retiredRule.oldServer: Repeated quantity could not exceed remaining deal quantity minus book stock.
retiredRule.replacement: No stock-based availability or quantity cap. Staff choose a positive order quantity; form defaults to remaining unshipped deal quantity.
retiredRule.migration: None; existing orders, stock, receipts and transfers remain unchanged. No automatic retry of the rejected order.

oldEligibilitySources: Material Request plus B24 transfer/ERP purchase progress
Sales Order and Delivery Note remaining quantities
newServerEligibilitySources: Material Request plus B24 transfer/ERP purchase progress
architecture.ui: Remaining plan quantity still determines selectable unshipped rows and the editable default quantity. Stock remains visible in the table but does not gate ordering.
architecture.compatibility: No API payload/schema change. Destination, deadline, positive quantity and common comment remain required. Existing automatic completion calculation, fail-closed reads, duplicate locks, reservations and shipment safeguards remain.

verification.localBuild: passed; subsequent changes only clarify selection hint/title
verification.browser: Real DealProductsWorkspace and production styles with mocked data: sufficient stock shows Заказать next to ✓ хватит, default quantity three is editable to four; active request and unreadable progress hide ordering. No live business order submitted.
verification.backendRegression: Completed request allows a new request with quantity four despite book stock three and plan quantity two. Original request stays unchanged; concurrent click and next unfinished request block another order; unreadable progress refuses creation.
verification.frontendRegression: Order candidates available at stock zero, partial, exact and surplus; active request/transfer, manual rows and fully shipped rows remain excluded. Duplicate product plan rows remain selectable.
verification.productionWrites: None during implementation; no replacement order created for deal 36874.

release: Prepared implementation; production remains on 88de177 until release approval.
